advisors.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
advisors.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
advisors.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`private.message_reaction_events\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`private.message_reactions\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

advisors.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
advisors.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
advisors.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.message_reactions_request(p_action text, p_data jsonb)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/message_reactions_request`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
